Peso-FinFlow Privacy Policy

Effective date: August 6, 2026

Peso-FinFlow ("the App") is a personal finance application developed by Alain Cabando. This policy explains how the App handles your information. The short version: the App is local-first and collects no personal data.

Data collection

The App does not collect, store, upload, or transmit any personal data. There is no account system, no analytics SDK, no advertising, and no crash-reporting service in the App.

Where your data lives

All of your financial information — accounts, transactions, budgets, bills, and settings — is stored exclusively on your device in a local database. Your data never leaves your device. The App does not connect to any server and requires no internet connection to function.

Optional backup files

If you choose to use the App's backup feature, a portable snapshot of your data is written to a location you select (such as Files or iCloud Drive). This file is created by you, where you choose to save it. No backup data is sent to the developer.

Face ID / Touch ID

If you enable biometric unlocking, the App uses your device's built-in Face ID or Touch ID only to locally authorize access to the App. Biometric data is processed by the operating system and is never stored by, or transmitted from, the App.

Data deletion

Because all data is stored locally, deleting the App from your device removes all of its data. You may also delete data at any time within the App.

Children's privacy

The App does not collect any personal information from anyone, including children.

Changes to this policy

This policy may be updated from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page.
